cli.rationale: The orca CLI ships with the desktop app and scripts a running Orca runtime; its registration location differs between the live and pinned docs (see limitations); orca serve runs the runtime headless. Scope: Orca desktop, Orca mobile companion, Orca CLI, Orca remote server and SSH. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to orca:ACC-01; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

claude-code.rationale: Orca launches and tracks existing CLI agents in terminals rather than embedding a harness: many CLI launchers are preconfigured (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, Gemini, Antigravity, OpenCode, Copilot CLI and others) and any other CLI can run in a terminal. Orca is not a model provider. Scope: Orca desktop, Orca remote server and SSH, Orca CLI.

gemini-cli.rationale: The current official preconfigured agent picker explicitly lists this CLI. Deeper chat/hooks/usage integration varies by harness.

antigravity.rationale: Orca v1.4.256 runs Antigravity chats through its managed official ACP server or a compatible host agy acp command. Antigravity structured chat has its own sign-in and cannot adopt terminal conversations; supported account types and runtime compatibility still apply.

local.rationale: Agents, terminals and browser run on the desktop by default. Scope: Orca desktop, Orca remote server and SSH.

own-server.rationale: SSH hosts and self-hosted Remote Orca Servers; current SSH installs its managed server and keeps sessions after client disconnect. Scope: Orca desktop, Orca remote server and SSH.

vendor-cloud.rationale: Docs state Orca does not sell managed VPS hosting; remote modes always use machines and cloud accounts you control. Scope: Orca desktop, Orca remote server and SSH.

worktree.rationale: Independent git worktrees; plain git works inside them. Scope: Orca desktop, Orca remote server and SSH.

container.rationale: Cloud VM recipes can start a cloud sandbox, VM or local Docker container per workspace (experimental). Scope: Orca desktop, Orca remote server and SSH.

vm.rationale: Same experimental per-workspace recipes (Vercel Sandbox, Fly, Modal, SSH hosts). Scope: Orca desktop, Orca remote server and SSH.

parallel-runs.rationale: Parallel agents in separate worktrees; the first-session guide runs three side by side. Scope: Orca desktop, Orca remote server and SSH.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Presets, cron expressions, RRULE and timezone. Scope: Orca CLI, Orca desktop, Orca remote server and SSH.

pr-workflow.rationale: Create PR or MR with a draft toggle on GitHub and GitLab; Bitbucket Cloud has no draft PRs and hides the Draft option (commit-push docs); auto-merge and stacked PRs on GitHub. Scope: Orca desktop.

review-ui.rationale: Per-worktree diff against the start-from ref and PR diffs. Scope: Orca desktop, Orca CLI.

license.rationale: Root MIT license, copyright 2026 Lovecast Inc.; Terms of Service state the application is licensed under MIT. Scope: Orca desktop, Orca mobile companion, Orca remote server and SSH, Orca Relay, push gateway and artifacts (vendor-hosted).

self-hosting.rationale: Run the desktop app or orca serve on your own machine; Enterprise page says Orca is self-hostable. Scope: Orca desktop, Orca remote server and SSH, Orca Relay, push gateway and artifacts (vendor-hosted).

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: Settings > Privacy, DO_NOT_TRACK and ORCA_TELEMETRY_DISABLED documented. Scope: Orca desktop.

free-tier.rationale: Free application advertised for macOS, Windows and Linux. Scope: Orca desktop.

starting-price.rationale: Free application advertised for macOS, Windows and Linux. Scope: Orca desktop.

web-client.rationale: The browser client pairs to a running user-owned Remote Orca Server and uses its runtime state. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to orca:ACC-01; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

issue-tracking.rationale: The cited orchestration guide requires enabling its Experimental switch, which it explicitly marks temporarily unavailable. Native Tasks on that disabled feature do not pass the current availability gate; external trackers do not meet this filter.

laptop-independent.rationale: A reachable Remote Orca Server or managed SSH host keeps agent processes running after the controlling laptop sleeps or disconnects.

compute.rationale: Orca does not sell hosting; remote modes use user machines.

no-paid-plan.rationale: Free and open source; the Enterprise page states no paid plan or fee.

free-plan.rationale: The published application is free and open source without a paid ADE plan. Existing provider subscriptions and model charges are separate from Orca application pricing.

subscription.rationale: The published application is free and open source without a paid ADE plan. Existing provider subscriptions and model charges are separate from Orca application pricing.

one-time.rationale: The published application is free and open source without a paid ADE plan. Existing provider subscriptions and model charges are separate from Orca application pricing.

byo-subscription.rationale: The finding explicitly documents existing Claude Code/Codex subscription logins and reuse of the installed agent CLIs.

coordinator.rationale: The orchestration guide explicitly says the required Experimental panel and activation switch are temporarily unavailable. A documented but currently unenableable coordinator cannot pass the availability gate.

roles.rationale: The pinned self-managed runtime uses paired-device scopes without a named human team-role or enterprise SSO implementation. External provider logins and infrastructure IAM are outside this scope.
